title: Research: UT4 two-target unit count is independent of dirty workspace
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR1662 leaves the two-target optimum between 14 and 16 with arbitrary dirty workspace. This contribution proves that extra workspace cannot lower that unit call count: C_r=C_2 for every finite r>=2, while the exact value remains 14,15 or16.

The new uniform lemma applies to every full formal UT4(F2) central-target word with r>=w>=2 and length L<=7w+1. Summing the six scalar span inequalities permits at most one extra span dimension. All factors therefore share a common upper/lower block orientation; active-corner compression preserves multiplication over the full noncommutative group algebra. Compressed nonzero rank-one factors remain legal, and zero identity factors are dropped. Every 14/15-call two-target word consequently reduces to exactlytwo roles. The direct 16-call two-role upper word then proves equality of the minima.

Only research/ut4-one-slack-workspace/ is added (12 files). No 14/15-call construction or nonexistence census is claimed. This does not compress arbitrary 16-call words or establish weighted-tariff workspace independence. No physical supplier, rational-frame identity, kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Task and overlap

Base main a18b4b0136d647529971e9fcb99fa83f5b9a0b81. Revision3 task bit-new-register-model, nonce e5da093483cfe0c1dfea3262d0f0935b, scope 7f5f4426ef796683c485. Scope explicitly changed from a shortest-identity construction attempt to a useful missing-workspace reduction for that same construction problem; TASK.json retains the original card and reason.

This complements [Aaron Wang/navinor's active two-role14-call search](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1647#discussioncomment-18916137), which leaves extra dirty roles open. We claim only that missing implication, not an overlapping census or an unpublished search result. [Complementary claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1647#discussioncomment-18916672).

Entry overlap covered537 open PR bodies including drafts; pre-submit numbered pagination found461 distinct PRs and only predecessor1662 in the UT4 scope. The helper also searched local metadata/ledger; live1163/1166 and relevantDiscussion claims were read. Concurrent merges prevent an atomic snapshot. Full Discussion pagination, all code diffs and unpublished work were not covered; no novelty guarantee. Six guidance/catalog/selected/model blobs and predecessorhead were rechecked unchanged at418e40eb2572d930b58c1cf9b82b41c0fc7ee08d and again at d78fe4bbb6f6b769e39586f8bb3ba8c31a31fd3a before publication.

## Validation

Run python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut4-one-slack-workspace. Registered replay passed in 11.855s on Python3.12.14/macOS26.5.2 arm64, standard library only; six fault-test groups and 20 workflow tests passed. Optimized isolated verification, source pins and staged whitespace checks pass.

Exact corroboration:3,969 ordered triangular pairs per orientation (7,938 recorded cases,7,209 distinct;729 overlap),1,524,096 full regular input columns,2,268 actually dropped factors,105 rank-slack profiles,10 known upper witnesses/2,560 basis columns. Separate literal4x4/regular-operator checker has four compression fixtures and actual mixed-orientation feedback controls. The inherited fixed17-term quotient replays4,096 products/4,913 basis triples. Real source/vendor/receipt corruption, illegal inputs, occupied outputs and optimized read-only relocation reject or pass as appropriate. Finitefixtures corroborate the written proof; they are not14/15-call witnesses. VALIDATION.json lists unrun obligations, including selected cold replay and kernel/physical/analytic transfer.

## Credit and next question

Credit @ToikY/PR1662 at 01cc02b164ecc4f9d84df3f56a1fe65b88daf390 for the six UT4 span containments and middle quotient. Its quotient.py is copied byte-for-byte with Gitblob/SHA256 in VENDOR.json, so replay needs no unmerged dependency checkout. This retained implementation is not claimed independently new.

Credit steph4n-gh/#1573 at 0b8c5a69297c794f2de22c04494c83e41300ae36, Arham Tahir/#1589 at 010ec8c01c0edbbb08b541be236ab78d096f2ca1, Hanson Sun/@bbMisk/#1607 at 9d6117918025cee6a0c5b7ef30ff8d936ca0621f and their retained lineage. Aaron Wang/navinor is credited for the complementary ongoing search, without endorsing its outcome. Apache-2.0; prepared for @ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and two bounded subagents. No independent human/kernel review claimed.

Next: independently audit navinor's eventual complete 14-call certificate; a rigorous r2 exclusion now transfers to every finite workspace. If14 is excluded, decide 15 on the same two-role 27-factor alphabet. Exact minima and complete search certificates remain open.
